title: Almost-everywhere inverse-power-of-two lower limsup density along Lipschitz fields of affine planes on Borel subsets of Euclidean space
source_title: Density estimate from below in relation to a conjecture of A. Zygmund on Lipschitz differentiation
author: Thierry De Pauw
difficulty_reason: A Lipschitz field of affine planes does not form a foliation to which the usual Lebesgue density theorem can simply be applied. Sections5–7 construct two rectifiable fibrations and quantitative coarea Jacobian bounds, then select transverse balls whose nonlinear stripes remain disjoint. The resulting near-full-volume lower bound closes the Section8 contradiction with the exact dimensional density constant after standard measure-theoretic foundations are allowed.
